audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was given to Ornn while whys[1] says 'concede the level'; Levels 4-5 and 6 were 'Skill' while whys[3] and whys[4] say Ornn detonates the burst and owns the all-in.
audit.why: Packet chart (Skill, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn) matches the prose and the 54.49% win rate; the stored chart contradicted its own why text on three rows.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 3 and 4 realigned in both layers, Level 6 raised to 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: R was described as a 'double knock-up'.
audit.why: Per the mirror audit already on disk (zac vs ornn): Call of the Forge God is 2500 range on a 140s rank-1 cooldown, the first pass slows and applies Brittle, and the recast is the knock-up. Restating it the same way from Ornn's side keeps the two pages consistent.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now says the first pass brittles and the recast knocks up.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Zac ability was named and the decisive grounding interaction was absent.
audit.why: Elastic Slingshot (E, 21/18/15/12/9s) is a dash — Ornn's Volcanic Rupture grounds it, which removes Zac's only engage. Unstable Matter (W, 5s) deals a percentage of max health, so stacking armour is the wrong answer. Stretching Strikes (Q, 14/12.5/11/9.5/8s, 800 range) is an auto-attack reset grab. Cell Division sheds blobs he reabsorbs to heal and revives him from bloblets, which is why anti-heal and stepping on blobs both matter. Let's Bounce! is 120s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Named all five, added cooldowns, and stated the grounding denial and the max-health damage.

audit.why: Elastic Slingshot at 21s rank 1 is the long punishable window; Unstable Matter at 5s never is.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns and the dos entries with values.

notes: Mirror (zac__ornn) was already audited and its findings were reused rather than re-derived: Ornn's Q leaves the pillar and E into that pillar is the knock-up, Bellows Breath applies Brittle on the final gout, and R is 2500 range / 140s with the knock-up on the recast. The level-chart flips here move rows toward Ornn, which matches the mirror's Zac-side ratings being the inverse.
